## Data

Monthly rainfall in millimetres, for one year.

```{python}
#| label: data
RAIN = [78, 52, 61, 45, 50, 41, 38, 49, 55, 83, 90, 86]
```

## Summary

```{python}
#| label: stats
def mean(xs):
    return sum(xs) / len(xs)


def wettest(xs):
    """The 1-based month with the most rain."""
    return xs.index(max(xs)) + 1
```

```{python}
print(f"mean {mean(RAIN):.1f} mm, wettest month {wettest(RAIN)}")
```

A display fence stays in the prose:

```python
wettest([1, 3, 2])  # 2
```
